description: Grades the panther-ivy-plugin:ivy orchestrator's journal final-entry shape (event, gate_status, evidence_paths_count_min) for each input prompt. Does NOT grade which specialist agent name was spawned — agent-name selection is internal to the orchestrator and may evolve. The journal final-entry contract is the stable observable. Cases mix verify (4) / build (4) / review (3) / triage (2) / meta (2) intents.
